day2_afternoon_class.name: Me
day2_afternoon_class.text: *The drag of afternoon classes is over. Sunset spills through the window, painting the classroom red. Free time at last.*

day2_afternoon_nurse_skip.name: Me
day2_afternoon_nurse_skip.text: *I open my eyes on the nurse's office bed. The sun is setting. I slept through every class, but resting next to the nurse left my body feeling light.*

day2_after_school.name: Me
day2_after_school.text: *The hallway feels far more familiar than yesterday. Let's see where my feet take me.*
choices: Find Seoyeon. The sunset would suit her.
Go deeper into Yuna's secret.
Track down the girl behind the mystery note -- Yuna.
Help Dain with practice at the gym.
Dain's voice is coming from the gym -- head that way.
Talk more with the nurse who looked after me.
The nurse's office. Something about the medicine scent draws me in.
Head to the teachers' office to see the homeroom teacher.

day2_after_nurse_stay.name: Me
day2_after_nurse_stay.text: *I make my way back to the nurse's office. She's still there, right where I left her.*

day2_after_seoyeon.name: Me
day2_after_seoyeon.text: *Student council room. I start helping Seoyeon sort through documents. The voice guiding me through the work is surprisingly calm and gentle.*

day2_after_seoyeon_work.name: Me
day2_after_seoyeon_work.text: *Lost in the paperwork, I look up to find the window steeped in red sunset. The room is filled with nothing but our breathing and the rustle of pages.*

day2_after_seoyeon_2.name: Seoyeon
day2_after_seoyeon_2.text: "Phew... done. {name}, seriously, thank you. You're surprisingly useful. ...That's a compliment, take it."

day2_after_seoyeon_3.name: Me
day2_after_seoyeon_3.text: *Seoyeon stretches and lets out a small smile. She looks tired, but her eyes in the sunset glow are clearer than usual.*
choices: Why are you always so all-in on everything, Seoyeon?
Let's call it a day. I'll walk you home.
You're really tense. Hold still for a second.

day2_seoyeon_why.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_why.text: "Why? ...Because someone has to. And if I give it my all, maybe at least one thing gets a little better."

day2_seoyeon_home_high.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_home_high.text: "Really...? *Seoyeon gently takes my arm.* I actually wanted to walk with you, {name}. ...Today's sunset is beautiful."

day2_seoyeon_home.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_home.text: "Walk me home? ...Yeah, that'd be nice, actually."

day2_seoyeon_home_low.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_home_low.text: "It's fine, I can get home on my own. Thanks for helping today."

day2_seoyeon_massage_high.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_massage_high.text: "Mmm... *Seoyeon closes her eyes and leans into it.* That's amazing... I had no idea your hands were this warm. ...Just a little more."

day2_seoyeon_massage.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_massage.text: "Ah...! Out of nowhere...! *She flinches, then gradually relaxes and closes her eyes.* ...That feels good. Thanks."

day2_seoyeon_massage_low.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_massage_low.text: *Seoyeon pulls away sharply.* "What are you doing? That's uncomfortable."

day2_seoyeon_night_talk.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_night_talk.text: "{name}... thanks for today. Being around you makes me forget everything that's weighing me down. Want to grab lunch together again tomorrow?"

day2_seoyeon_dain_encounter.name: Me
day2_seoyeon_dain_encounter.text: *Leaving the student council room with Seoyeon, we run into someone in the hallway.*

day2_seoyeon_dain_met.name: Dain
day2_seoyeon_dain_met.text: "Oh?! The one from the snack bar earlier!! {name}!! Wow, hanging out with the student council president?!"

day2_seoyeon_dain_new.text: "Huh?! You're the transfer student, right?! Whoa, already tight with the council president?!"

day2_seoyeon_dain_react.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_dain_react.text: "*Seoyeon looks slightly caught off guard.* ...Dain? Hi. We just finished up and were heading out."

day2_seoyeon_dain_choice.name: Dain
day2_seoyeon_dain_choice.text: "Oh, really?! I just wrapped up practice! {name}, hang out with me next time too~!!"
choices: Yeah, for sure!
I'm with Seoyeon today, so...
*Grinning* Would be great to hang out with both of you.

day2_seoyeon_dain_no.name: Dain
day2_seoyeon_dain_no.text: "Aww~ bummer!! You'd better make it up to me next time!"

day2_seoyeon_dain_both.name: Me
day2_seoyeon_dain_both.text: *Seoyeon's and Dain's expressions freeze at the exact same time. Did I just step on another mine...*

day2_seoyeon_dain_both_2.name: Dain
day2_seoyeon_dain_both_2.text: "...What? Both of us?! What's that supposed to mean?!"

day2_seoyeon_dain_both_3.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_dain_both_3.text: "*Seoyeon smiles coolly.* {name} sure is popular. The type who tells everyone what they want to hear, I guess."

day2_seoyeon_dain_both_4.name: Dain
day2_seoyeon_dain_both_4.text: "Geez, the president's sharp! But honestly? She's got a point!! {name}, keep that up and you'll lose both of us?!"

day2_seoyeon_dain_both_5.name: Me
day2_seoyeon_dain_both_5.text: *Both of them are eyeing each other, then me. The atmosphere just got real frosty...*

day2_seoyeon_dain_end.name: Me
day2_seoyeon_dain_end.text: *Dain waves and heads off. Seoyeon's expression seems oddly stiff.*

day2_seoyeon_contact_ask.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_contact_ask.text: "Oh wait. I never got your number, did I? I have a feeling I'll keep wanting to talk to you... Mind sharing it?"
choices: Sure, text me anytime. Here's my number.
Sorry, maybe once we're a bit closer.

day2_seoyeon_contact_success.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_contact_success.text: "Thanks. Then I'm actually going to text you, okay? Brace yourself. Get home safe, {name}."

day2_seoyeon_contact_fail.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_contact_fail.text: "...Right, got it. I was being too forward. Sorry. See you at school tomorrow."

day2_after_yuna.name: Me
day2_after_yuna.text: *The library annex. Stepping into the old building, cool air wraps around me.*

day2_after_yuna_met.name: Yuna
day2_after_yuna_met.text: "...You came. Follow me. There's something I want to show you."

day2_after_yuna_new.text: "You... came here because you're curious about me, right? This school has a very deep secret."

day2_after_yuna_new_follow.name: Yuna
day2_after_yuna_new_follow.text: "{name}... I'll remember that. Follow me. This is for your eyes only."

day2_after_yuna_follow_again.name: Me
day2_after_yuna_follow_again.text: *I follow Yuna back down to the underground storage. The air is even colder than before. Faint sunset light barely reaches through the window.*

day2_after_yuna_follow_new.name: Me
day2_after_yuna_follow_new.text: *I follow Yuna down to the underground storage. Dust-covered space with a strange chill hanging in the air. Sunset light barely seeps through the window.*

day2_after_yuna_3_pre_again.name: Yuna
day2_after_yuna_3_pre_again.text: "Those patterns from earlier... don't they look even more unsettling in the sunset?"

day2_after_yuna_3_pre_new.name: Yuna
day2_after_yuna_3_pre_new.text: "Look, {name}. These patterns carved into the wall... they match what I've been tracking."

day2_after_yuna_3.name: Me
day2_after_yuna_3.text: *Yuna points to a gap in the wall. A strange eye-like shape is carved there in red.*
choices: What does this even mean?
*Taking Yuna's hand* It's creepy -- let's get out of here.
This eye... it feels like it's watching us.

day2_yuna_meaning.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_meaning.text: "Surveillance... or protection. Who it's for -- I still don't know."

day2_yuna_scary_high.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_scary_high.text: *Yuna grips my hand tightly.* "...Your hand is warm. It's been so long since I felt warmth like this. Let's go. But... don't let go of my hand."

day2_yuna_scary_low.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_scary_low.text: *Yuna shakes off my hand.* "Why are you grabbing me. Bold move for a scaredy-cat. If you want to leave, leave on your own."

day2_yuna_eye.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_eye.text: "...Same light. This school might be a prison, or a lab. And we're being tested inside it."

day2_yuna_night_talk.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_night_talk.text: "This isn't just graffiti. It's connected to the founding purpose of this school. {name}, you've already chosen a path you can't turn back from."

day2_yuna_nurse_encounter.name: Me
day2_yuna_nurse_encounter.text: *Leaving the storage with Yuna, we run into someone in the hallway.*

day2_yuna_nurse_met.name: Nurse
day2_yuna_nurse_met.text: "Oh my, {name}? What are you doing here at this hour? ...And who's this student?"

day2_yuna_nurse_new.text: "Hmm? Students down here at this hour? This old storage room is dangerous... Oh, I'm the school nurse."

day2_yuna_nurse_choice.name: Nurse
day2_yuna_nurse_choice.text: "*She gives Yuna a loaded look.* ...Is that so? Be careful. Dangerous things hide in dark places."
choices: *Take Yuna's hand* We will, thanks.
We were just taking a walk, that's all.
*Just nod silently.*

day2_yuna_nurse_excuse.name: Nurse
day2_yuna_nurse_excuse.text: "Is that so? Try picking a brighter path next time."

day2_yuna_nurse_silent.name: Nurse
day2_yuna_nurse_silent.text: "*She watches us with a meaningful look, then walks on.*"

day2_yuna_nurse_end.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_nurse_end.text: "...That person is off. She's not just a normal school nurse. {name}, be careful."

day2_yuna_contact_ask.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_contact_ask.text: "To share secrets... we need a way to reach each other. Leave your number here."
choices: Sure. I want to know more about you.
Sorry, I'm still being cautious.

day2_yuna_contact_success.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_contact_success.text: "...Done. We're connected now. When I call, come."

day2_yuna_contact_fail.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_contact_fail.text: "...Fine. I won't force you. Just remember -- chances like this don't come often."

day2_after_dain.name: Me
day2_after_dain.text: *I push open the gym doors. Battle cries and the thwack of volleyballs come pouring out.*

day2_after_dain_met.name: Dain
day2_after_dain_met.text: "Oh!! {name}!! Perfect timing!! Help me with practice!! Please!!"

day2_after_dain_practice.name: Me
day2_after_dain_practice.text: *After helping Dain drill spikes, I'm soaked in sweat. Outside, it's already getting dark.*

day2_after_dain_new.text: "Haa, haa... You've got serious energy!! We're in perfect sync for a first time!!"

day2_after_dain_new_name_ask.text: "I'm Dain Jung, Class 2-3!! What's your name?!"

day2_after_dain_3.name: Me
day2_after_dain_3.text: *Dain wipes her sweat with a towel and hands me a cold drink.*
choices: Your tosses were great -- I was just hitting them.
Actually? Let's not hold back. Next time, a real match.
Tteokbokki after a workout is peak happiness, right?!

day2_dain_praise.name: Dain
day2_dain_praise.text: "Oh come on, don't be modest!! You've got real skills! Anyway, thanks to you, practice was amazing today!! Thanks!!"

day2_dain_match.name: Dain
day2_dain_match.text: "Oh?! Feeling confident?! Alright, let's bet on it!! Loser buys tteokbokki!! I'm NOT losing!!"

day2_dain_food.name: Dain
day2_dain_food.text: "RIGHT?! You get it!! Tteokbokki with fried stuff on the side... man, just thinking about it makes me happy!!"

day2_dain_night_talk.name: Dain
day2_dain_night_talk.text: "Wow!! You're seriously fired up!! I almost want to recruit you for the team!! Get home safe, {name}!!"

day2_dain_yuna_encounter.name: Me
day2_dain_yuna_encounter.text: *Just then, I notice someone passing by the gym window. A pale-skinned girl walking quietly down the corridor.*

day2_dain_yuna_spot.name: Dain
day2_dain_yuna_spot.text: "*Dain looks out the window and shrinks a little.* Th-that girl... doesn't she give you the creeps?! She's always wandering around alone like that...!!"

day2_dain_yuna_choice.name: Me
choices: Yuna? She's just the quiet type. Don't worry.
No idea, first time seeing her.
Dain, you're way brighter and better.

day2_dain_yuna_know.name: Dain
day2_dain_yuna_know.text: "Huh?! You know her?! Wow, {name}, you're friends with everyone! But I'm your BEST friend, right?! RIGHT?!"

day2_dain_yuna_unknown.name: Dain
day2_dain_yuna_unknown.text: "Right?! Something's just different about her vibe... Anyway, when you're with me, don't think about stuff like that!! Eyes on me!!"

day2_dain_yuna_compliment.name: Dain
day2_dain_yuna_compliment.text: "Wha-- where did THAT come from~!! *Her face goes red and she punches my shoulder.* My heart almost exploded!! ...Because of the compliment!! No other reason!!"

day2_dain_yuna_end.name: Me
day2_dain_yuna_end.text: *Yuna disappears into the distance. Dain still seems bothered, but snaps back to her bright self soon enough.*

day2_dain_contact_ask.name: Dain
day2_dain_contact_ask.text: "{name}!! We're gonna keep hanging out, right?! Contact info is a must!! Punch in your number!!"
choices: Yeah, obviously! Here's my number.
We'll see each other at school tomorrow anyway.

day2_dain_contact_success.name: Dain
day2_dain_contact_success.text: "Saved!! I'm texting you the second I get bored, so be ready!!"

day2_dain_contact_fail.name: Dain
day2_dain_contact_fail.text: "Wow, playing hard to get?! Fine!! Come to the gym tomorrow -- I'm not letting you leave until you hand it over!!"

day2_after_nurse.name: Me
day2_after_nurse.text: *I open the nurse's office door. A soft herbal scent and the sight of her reading a book greet me.*

day2_after_nurse_met.name: Nurse
day2_after_nurse_met.text: "Oh, {name}. Back again? Are you actually sick, or did you just want to see my face?"

day2_after_nurse_met_high.name: Nurse
day2_after_nurse_met_high.text: *She smiles softly.* "{name}. You come so often, I'm starting to look forward to it. Come on in."

day2_after_nurse_met_check.name: Nurse
day2_after_nurse_met_check.text: "Oh, {name}. The nurse's office after school... something wrong?"

day2_after_nurse_met_low.name: Nurse
day2_after_nurse_met_low.text: *She says flatly.* "...{name}, you're here again? What is it."

day2_after_nurse_invited.name: Nurse
day2_after_nurse_invited.text: "{name}. You haven't forgotten about tonight's plans, have you? If you rushed here because you couldn't wait... I'm genuinely touched."

day2_after_nurse_new.name: Nurse
day2_after_nurse_new.text: "Oh my, a new face. Transfer student? I'm the school nurse. Nice to meet you."

day2_after_nurse_3.name: Me
day2_after_nurse_3.text: *She adjusts her glasses and studies me closely.*
choices: I came because I missed you.
Just wanted some quiet time.
This room smells incredible.

day2_nurse_miss.name: Nurse
day2_nurse_miss.text: "Honesty like that deserves a reward, doesn't it?"

day2_nurse_miss_normal.name: Nurse
day2_nurse_miss_normal.text: "Honesty is nice... but saying things like that to a teacher can get you misunderstood, {name}. Still, it is kind of cute."

day2_nurse_miss_low.name: Nurse
day2_nurse_miss_low.text: *She looks at me coolly over her glasses.* "...We're not quite on those terms yet, are we? Keep the jokes appropriate. Just rest here for today."

day2_nurse_rest.name: Nurse
day2_nurse_rest.text: "Fair enough. Go lie down on that bed. I won't bother you."

day2_nurse_aroma.name: Nurse
day2_nurse_aroma.text: "Oh, good nose. I blended that aroma oil myself. It's meant to calm the mind."

day2_nurse_night_talk.name: Nurse
day2_nurse_night_talk.text: *She smiles gently and strokes my hair.* "You came because you wanted more time with me, didn't you? Fine, I'll stay with you a little longer today. Special treatment."

day2_nurse_night_talk_2.name: Me
day2_nurse_night_talk_2.text: *Chatting with the nurse, the sky outside went from sunset to dark. Reluctantly, I left the school with a promise for next time.*

day2_nurse_contact_already_have_talk.name: Nurse
day2_nurse_contact_already_have_talk.text: "{name}, we already have each other's numbers, right? If you've got free time tonight, text me. I'll be waiting."
choices: I will.
Forget the phone... can I come to your place tonight?

nurse_contact_home_success_after.name: Nurse
nurse_contact_home_success_after.text: *She smiles suggestively and whispers near my ear.* "Oh my... {name}, bolder than I thought. Sure, want to come over tonight? I'll send you the address. But it's our secret, okay?"

nurse_contact_home_fail_after.name: Nurse
nurse_contact_home_fail_after.text: *She giggles.* "Oh my, {name}! Adorable. But my place might be a bit soon, don't you think? Just text me later."

day2_nurse_contact_ask.name: Nurse
day2_nurse_contact_ask.text: "{name}, why don't you save my number? If you're ever sick or need someone to talk to, reach out."
choices: Yes, please!
That's a bit much for now.

day2_nurse_contact_success.name: Nurse
day2_nurse_contact_success.text: "Good. I'll text you later, then. Have a good evening, {name}."

day2_nurse_contact_fail.name: Nurse
day2_nurse_contact_fail.text: "Oh, playing hard to get? Let me know if you change your mind. Get home safe!"

day2_after_teacher.name: Me
day2_after_teacher.text: *I open the teachers' office door. In the empty room, the homeroom teacher sits alone under a desk lamp, reviewing documents.*

day2_after_teacher_2.name: Teacher
day2_after_teacher_2.text: "Oh my, {name}? What are you doing here at this hour? Haven't you gone home yet?"

day2_after_teacher_3.name: Teacher
day2_after_teacher_3.text: "There's a pile of paperwork due this week... Can't believe I'm showing you this haggard side of me during your first week here."
choices: Let me help! We'll finish way faster together.
Hang in there! Want me to make you some coffee?
You're pushing yourself too hard. I'm worried about you.

day2_after_teacher_work.name: Me
day2_after_teacher_work.text: *I sat down next to her and started helping sort papers. In the quiet office, only the rhythmic sound of pages turning fills the air.*

day2_after_teacher_work_2.name: Teacher
day2_after_teacher_work_2.text: "Thank you, {name}. That was a huge help. I'd still be buried in this if I were alone."

day2_after_teacher_branch.name: Me
day2_after_teacher_branch.text: *The teacher watches me quietly, seemingly lost in thought.*

day2_after_teacher_special.name: Teacher
day2_after_teacher_special.text: *She suddenly leans toward me. A hint of perfume and warm breath reach me.*

day2_after_teacher_special_2.name: Teacher
day2_after_teacher_special_2.text: "{name}, you're a genuinely special student. It's only been two days... why does it feel like I've known you for years?"

day2_after_teacher_special_3.name: Teacher
day2_after_teacher_special_3.text: "As a thank-you for today's help... let me drive you home. We can talk more in the car."

day2_after_teacher_normal.name: Teacher
day2_after_teacher_normal.text: "Well, it's late. Head home. I'll wrap up and leave too. Good work today, {name}."

day2_after_teacher_coffee.name: Teacher
day2_after_teacher_coffee.text: "Oh, coffee? The thought is sweet, but I can't have a student make it for me. Here, take a candy instead."

day2_after_teacher_worry.name: Teacher
day2_after_teacher_worry.text: "Thanks for worrying. I'm fine, really! Having a student as thoughtful as {name} makes me feel reassured."
